Clients ExxonMobil ,Nestle Position Solution Architect Description ExxonMobil is big player of Energy domain they deal in Fuels & Lubes globally. Managing and creating environment setup. Analyzing, understanding, and documenting the business processes in detail where required (PDD) with Business Analyst. Creating TDD (Technical Design Document) based on the given requirements and providing end-to-end solution from requirement gathering till maintenance of the project/module as a Solution Architect. Involved in pre- development discussion with client on solution as per the requirement or discussion with SMEs on creating the PDD (Process Design Document) and SDD as per the given requirements. Able to create interactive dashboards with filters/slicers and chose the right visuals to help highlight in an easily understandable mode. Publish the Reports and Dashboards to Power BI Service for end User Consumption by creating and managing workspace and app. Documenting, designing, and modeling solutions and explaining, representing, and discussing the same with the team and applying experience, knowledge to future solution Performed Email activities for exceptions notifications & send templates to customers. Involved in code review and fine tuning the code for performance related issues and worked on debugging application for fixing bugs and Production support. Designing, creating, and maintaining flows, actions, and triggers. Creating and maintaining documentation to support the development of automated solutions. Troubleshoot and debug automated processes and workflows. Monitor and maintain the performance of automated processes and workflows. Getting multiple Appreciation mails from the client-side for creating and completing work in the given timelines. Extensively involved in the code review and monitoring the teams to ensure the deliverables are smoothly delivered on time. Managing the team and delegating the task to the team on daily basis to close all the open defects on time and provide support as and when required. Supporting existing processes and implementing change requirements as part of a structured change control process. Data gathering & designing in Power BI Finally Integrated to Automation.

Involved in code review and fine tuning the code for performance related issues and worked on debugging application for fixing bugs and Production support. Designing, creating, and maintaining flows, actions, and triggers. Creating and maintaining documentation to support the development of automated solutions. Troubleshoot and debug automated processes and workflows. Monitor and maintain the performance of automated processes and workflows. Getting multiple Appreciation mails from the client-side for creating and completing work in the given timelines. Extensively involved in the code review and monitoring the teams to ensure the deliverables are smoothly delivered on time. Managing the team and delegating the task to the team on daily basis to close all the open defects on time and provide support as and when required. Supporting existing processes and implementing change requirements as part of a structured change control process. Data gathering & designing in Power BI Finally Integrated to Automation.
